global: {fief} handed out like a tavern tab. Fine. Let's see how long it stays in one pair of hands this time.
Back in the first war, a fief that came easy usually left just as easy. I'll be watching {fief} with interest.
Some of us spent years earning a keep. Others got one from a single audience. Enjoy the walls, {player}.
Could be a fine gift for {player}. Could also be a fine target. Hope the garrison is paid up.
Lord-granted fiefs are nice until the neighbors start asking why. Expect questions from {fief}'s borders soon.
Ruler's favorites get a castle and a lot of enemies. Hope {player} brought spare soldiers.
whisper: {player}, I don't say this to be unkind, but {fief} came too easy. Easy things get watched closely here.
Congratulations on {fief}. I'll keep my opinion of the grant to myself for now, but I have one.

A new holder for {fief}. I've seen this movie before, and it ended with three rebellions and a fire.
Good to see the ruler rewarding someone. Let's see whether the rest of us get any notice first.
Fiefs are only as good as the people willing to defend them. Time will show what {player} is made of.
Hm. {fief} under new management. I'll reserve judgment until the first harvest comes in.
Whoever holds {fief} now, I hope they keep the mill running. Nothing sours a region like empty bread ovens.

I'm not sure whether to congratulate you or pity you. Ask me again after the first winter at {fief}.
The ruler's favor is a good start. Keeping the people of {fief} happy is the harder job.
Welcome to the responsibility side of things. The tavern sweets are much nicer than the tax ledgers.
If you want advice on {fief}, ask before you rebuild anything. I learned that one with a collapsed wall.

global: Well earned, {player}. {fief} is in good hands, and I'll say so to anyone who asks.

Good to see {player} getting a proper reward. The old hands have been waiting on this for a while.

The best grants go to people who already act like lords. Congratulations on {fief}, {player}.
I remember the first time I was handed a fief. Tired, happy, and worried about the roof. Enjoy it, {player}.
whisper: Congratulations on {fief}, {player}. Send word if you want me to look over the defenses sometime.
